games.description: A solo Chinese dreamcore horror trial about a student’s abusive home and internet-addiction treatment. Sark manages sanity, translates clues, searches for passwords, and surrenders before solving the house.
games.title: Aijin

games.description: A solo look through Planet Blip’s strange television programming, flipping between broadcasts, ads, interviews and text services. This is a channel-surfing visit rather than a complete viewing of the network.
games.title: Blippo+

games.description: A solo trip through an experimental game about pleasure and body awareness, exploring its surreal chambers and riding the final ascent.
games.title: CLTRS

games.description: A solo sample of Q-Games’ surreal particle-world adventure. Sark shoots dream bubbles to materialize the scenery, follows the wandering soldier and talking objects, and leaves the larger story unfinished after the early dream sequences.
games.title: Dreams of Another

games.description: A solo interactive story about a promising player and a demanding mother. Sark follows the school tournament, professional career and family crisis, then reaches the bad ending.
games.title: GAME

games.description: A solo first visit to the dead civilization. Sark learns the hovercraft controls, defeats the opening boss, explores the vertical city and side routes, and tackles another bullet-hell encounter before moving on.
games.title: Hovercrafts x Nihilism

games.description: A surreal solo journey from a deceptively peaceful village into distorted dream spaces. Sark works through the cryptic dialogue and looping realities, survives the strange obstacle routes and hunts the invisible entities before the closing sequence.
games.title: Lobotomy

games.description: A short solo attempt at the echolocation mansion. Sark uses sound to reveal rooms, searches for the valve and fuel, and abandons the escape attempt after another death and reset.
games.title: Lost Files 1978

games.description: Sark tries the opening surreal platforming challenges, learning split controls and newly introduced abilities before stopping at the bus-gap jump.
games.title: Saturday Sabado

games.description: Sark tries the opening of an abstract science-fiction thought experiment. A relaunch gets him past an initial obstacle, but missing audio and another apparent lockup end the short visit.
games.title: Simulation Requires Supervision

games.description: Sark takes on a succession of brainrot bosses using stamina, dodges and increasingly fast slaps. He clears the show, unlocks endless mode and finds more fun than he expected in the ridiculous arena.
games.title: Slappingrot

games.description: A brief attempt at the psychedelic shooter is dominated by capture problems. Sark gets a glimpse of play before postponing it to fix the stream setup.
games.title: TAMASHIKA

games.description: Sark tours a largely deserted ruined-city shooter, tries to make sense of its weapons and shop, then returns years later for another look at its strange maps.
games.title: Zumbido Seele
